about.title: A Luanda company that imports and distributes medicines.
about.p1: Novo Anjo Farma imports, distributes and sells medicines and hospital equipment. Our base is in Cacuaco, Luanda.
about.p2: We have the logistics and the finance to supply pharmacies and health services. On quality, we accept no compromise.

aboutPage.title: About Novo Anjo Farma
aboutPage.intro: We import, distribute and sell medicines and hospital equipment from Luanda.
aboutPage.authorizedTitle: What we are licensed to distribute
aboutPage.authorizedText: We are authorised to distribute and sell essential medicines for human use, including specialist medicines and medicines that contain psychotropic substances. Our range includes antispasmodics, heart and circulation medicines, consumables, surgical items, anti-inflammatories, capsules and syrups, hospital equipment and laboratory supplies, among others.
aboutPage.missionText: Good-quality health products at affordable prices, available across Angola.
aboutPage.visionText: We want to lead the market. We are starting with over 1000 products, with and without prescription, across many treatment areas.
